data.name: Export_ReadmeCommon
Export_ReadmeJson
data.value:
## Usage
This ZIP is not tailored to a specific engine — unpack it wherever your game or pipeline expects it and read the JSON files with any JSON parser.

data.name: Export_ReadmeUnity
data.value:
## Usage in Unity
Unpack the ZIP into the root directory of your Unity project: the content lands under `Assets/StreamingAssets/GameDevManager/` and ships with the build unchanged. At runtime you reach it through `Application.streamingAssetsPath`.
For reading it, the package `com.unity.nuget.newtonsoft-json` (Newtonsoft Json.NET) is recommended, because Unity's `JsonUtility` handles neither nested lists nor GUIDs as strings comfortably.

data.name: Export_ReadmeUnreal
data.value:
## Usage in Unreal Engine
Unpack the ZIP into the root directory of your Unreal project: the content lands under `Content/GameDevManager/`. JSON files can be read at runtime with `FFileHelper::LoadFileToString` and `FJsonSerializer`; alternatively you can import individual files as a DataTable in the editor.

data.name: Export_ReadmeGodot
data.value:
## Usage in Godot
Unpack the ZIP into the root directory of your Godot project: the content lands under `res://gamedevmanager/`. At runtime you load it with `FileAccess.get_file_as_string()` and `JSON.parse_string()`.
